name: English
meta_title: Omega Player — free offline music player for Android
meta_desc: Offline MP3 and FLAC player: crossfade, 10-band equalizer, 3D spatial audio, Android Auto, Wear OS. No ads, no account, nothing leaves your phone.
cta: Get it free on Google Play
hero_title: Your music is already on your phone.
hero_lead: Omega Player is the player it deserves.
manifesto: A complete offline audio player, built to make the most of the library you already own. No account to create, no ads, no subscription. Your MP3, FLAC, OGG and M4A files are picked up on their own, and your music follows you anywhere, even in airplane mode.
s1_body: Crossfade: the next track starts while the last one fades out. Silence at the start and end of a file is skipped automatically. Levelled volume: every track is analysed once so it plays at the same perceived loudness as the rest.
s2_body: 10-band equalizer: adjust the response curve with a single gesture. 3D spatial audio: an immersive render for headphones that places the sound stage around you.
s3_body: Omega Player measures the tempo and the tone of your tracks to line up a queue that holds together instead of killing the mood. You keep full control to reorder it at any time.
s4_title: A library that keeps itself tidy
s4_body: Automatic playlists: dynamic sorting by genre, with no effort from you. Sort your way: by recently added, recently played, length, title or tempo.
s5_body: 27 visual moods, between animated backgrounds and foreground effects.
w_auto: Your whole library on the car screen.
w_wear: Drive playback from your watch. The watch app pairs with your phone over Bluetooth.
w_screens: A dedicated tablet layout in landscape, a home screen widget and lock screen controls.
w_sleep: Set the music to fade out and stop for the night.
video_note: Nothing loads or plays until you press it. The videos have music.
p_tracking: Zero tracking: no profile, no usage statistics, no identifier collected.
p_server: No server: the app contains no remote server address at all and works entirely without a network. Crash reports stay on your device.
source_title: You stay in charge of the source
source_p1: Omega Player has no catalogue and wants none: it plays your files, full stop. Nothing is installed for you, nothing runs behind your back, nothing nudges you towards a service.
source_p2: And if you do want to plug an online source into it, you pick the extension, you install it, and it answers to you alone.
price_title: A pricing model you can read in one line
price_p1: The app is 100% free and already includes all 27 visual moods — kept for life by early adopters.
price_p2: The entire playback engine (spatial audio, equalizer, playlists, queue, Android Auto, Wear OS) will stay free, with no restriction. Only five exclusive visual moods, offered later on, will ever be a paid option.
final_lead: Your music is already on your phone.
